info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Terminal Configuration API
info.description: The Update Terminal Configuration API enables businesses to modify the settings and parameters of specific terminals in the payment processing ecosystem. By providing the terminal ID, users can adjust configurations such as payment methods, security settings, and operational parameters. This endpoint is particularly useful for system administrators managing multiple terminals to ensure they are optimized for current business needs. Typical consumers include IT teams and payment system managers seeking to maintain efficient terminal operations.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the configuration for the specified terminal identified by RES-100045. You can modify various attributes as needed to ensure the terminal operates correctly within your system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to partially update the terminal with the identifier RES-100045. It allows you to modify specific attributes of the terminal based on the provided JSON schema.

200.description: Request processed successfully, terminal details updated.
